La ricerca dei giochi funziona senza chi: Searching for games works without a key. Hours played do not: Steam only exposes them to those with a Web API key. You set it once.
Vai su <code>https://steamcommunity.com/: Go to https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey and sign in with your Steam account. localhost is fine in the domain field. You get a 32-character string.

La chiave sta <strong>solo</strong> nell: The key lives only in the environment variable: it never lands in a project file, never enters git, and this page never asks you for it in a text field. Treat it like a password for your Steam account — do not paste it into a chat.

Su Steam apri il tuo profilo, <strong>ta: On Steam open your profile, right-click the page → Copy page URL, and paste it here. The name you see on the profile does not work: Steam can only resolve the custom address (the part after /id/), which many profiles do not have.
L'import porta titolo, copertina e ore,: The import brings title, cover and hours, but not the genres. This asks Steam for them one by one — no key needed.
I generi di Steam sono pochi e grossi &m: Steam genres are few and broad — half the library is «Action». Tags actually tell things apart («Souls-like», «Open World») and they are what the suggestions use. Valve does not expose them, so they come from SteamSpy: public, no key, but English only and one request per second, so it is slower.
